title.en: Reflection and images in a plane mirror

text.en:
Ravi saw himself in the mirror and noticed his right hand looked like a left hand.
"The image is laterally inverted," said the teacher.

A plane mirror reflects light and forms an image. The image is the same size as the object and appears as far behind the mirror as the object is in front.
The image is laterally inverted: left and right are swapped, which is why AMBULANCE is written reversed on ambulances.
The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

problem.en: How far behind the mirror is the image if you stand 1 m in front?

text.en: The image is as far behind as the object is in front.

prompt.en: A friend says a plane mirror makes a smaller image. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: The image is the same size.

points.en: Plane mirror images are same size.
